description: Conversational exploration mode to deeply understand a new subject before any formal scoping begins. Use this skill whenever a user starts a new topic, feature, or initiative and wants to think it through before writing anything formal — even if they don't use the word "discovery". Trigger on: "je commence un nouveau sujet", "on réfléchit à une feature", "j'ai une idée", "on nous a demandé de faire X", "je sais pas trop par où commencer", "qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?", "on a un problème avec Y", or any early-stage exploratory conversation about a product or technical topic. This skill comes BEFORE macro-scoping. Do not produce a formal document until the user explicitly asks for it.
